Testing a simple inverse-error weighted combination on the full pool to see if direct error weighting beats the softmax approach.

The series shows unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust DBA on the full pool may improve over weighted combos.

test per‑horizon top‑k weighting on the stable pool4 to capture horizon‑specific strengths (ranking unstable, strong seasonality).

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.9991 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.088); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.012.
